Ruling-ref: the maintainer, 2026-11-20T09:18Z, on seat 7's decision card, picked option B: 「删组织时一并删单位」 (the organization delete's own cascade is the one exemption from the sys_unit delete refusal; every other context still refuses). Relayed by seat 7 to the d7-D area thread · 2026-11-20T09:21Z

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:server` · `pm:blocked` (behind #35489 / PR #35805); rationale: area:data · Bug · Broken once PR #35805 lands (an organization that ever created a unit can no longer be deleted: the delete is restricted by its units, and units refuse every delete) · admins offboarding tenants, rare but with no remedy → p2 · size S. The maintainer ruled the fix, option B, verbatim: 「删组织时一并删单位」. Land it with or right after PR #35805, so no window ships where an organization cannot be deleted.
